determination: The 1,326 automated-inventory figure is a static lexical token count of the regex \b(it|test)\s*\( ; the 1,300 figure is the runtime executed-and-passed case count. They measure different things. There are zero skipped, todo, or excluded tests. The controlling figure for Volume 1 is 1,300 executed and passed.
overcount_root_cause: Automated inventory overcounted because the static counter matched \b(it|test)\s*\( tokens that are not executed test registrations: 13 regex .test() method calls (word boundary after '.') and 24 it(/test( substrings inside comments and string/template literals (assertion messages and expected-output fixtures) — 37 non-registration tokens against 1,289 literal code it(/test( tokens. Runtime additionally expands two parameterized it.each() blocks (6 cases) that the static regex never counts. Net static-vs-executed difference of 26 is entirely a parser-semantics artifact.
